h: Fulani leaders reportedly present three demands to Tinubu on the N30 trillion livestock sector
p: Fulani leaders have reportedly set out three requests to President Tinubu about Nigeria's livestock sector, which is said to be worth about N30 trillion. The group wants the sector given more attention and support from government.
more: The sector supports millions of herders and traders across the country.
The presidency has not yet been reported to have responded.
